snippet.title: Serenity | JRPG Game Teaser
snippet.description:
WISHLIST HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4422070/Serenity/

Serenity is a Story-rich JRPG, reflect based bullet hell with main genres: Dreamcore, Weirdcore, Nostalgiacore, Liminal & Psychological horror. Wishlist now, subscribe for more details soon on the DEMO & KICKSTARTER!


Updates & Support:
